description: Definitions for b2b properties inside the team admin console

access_path.description: From which button does an admin access the domain dark-web monitoring page

audit_log_count.description: Number of logs downloaded when using the CSV download of the audit logs in TAC

audit_log_download_error.description: The error type for a CSV download of the audit logs in TAC

b2b_plan_tier.description: Plan tiers for b2b. Deprecated because this is a duplicate of server events that are the reference for this kind of information.

domain_verification_step.description: The domain verification (DV) step and its trigger description: starting domain verification, confirming dns information, domain verification completed and domain verification error

error_checkout.description: The error message triggered after a checkout fails

has_clicked_cta.description: Whether an in-app message CTA was clicked on or not

has_cta.description: Whether an in-app message has at least one CTA attached to it or not

has_promo.description: Whether the admin used a promotional code on the buy_seat screen or not

import_size.description: Number of emails imported in one file

initial_seat_count.description: Seats available before any additional seat purchase

invite_count.description: Number of invites sent through the team admin console

invite_resent_count.description: Number of invites that triggered a re-invite

is_discarded.description: Whether an in-app message was discarded by the admin (with or without interacting)

is_domain_verification_completed.description: False when the event occurs during the domain verification process or prior (if not started)

is_first_visit.description: Whether an admin is making their first visit to the domain dark web monitoring page or not

is_import.description: Whether an import is associated with the invite process or not

is_resend.description: Whether the invites are triggered through the resend button or not

plan_change_step.description: The step taken in the tac/account/change_plan funnel by the admin

purchased_seat_count.description: Seats purchased during the buying process

risk_detection_setup_step.description: Possible actions during Risk Detection setup

seat_added_count.description: Number of seats added through an invite due to lack of available seats

scim_setup_step.description: Step in the confidential SCIM setup

splunk_setup_step.description: Step in the splunk integration setup

tac_notification.description: Type of in-app message that is displayed to the user as detailed in the following sheet : https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13g0WI25d4PGEPgi6EEXCioKHoWdsO1nju-e4iC61HcY/edit?usp=sharing
